QUOTE: Add a `#define MBEDTLS_ERR_<MODULE>_<NAME>` with a negative value to the module's public header (for example `include/mbedtls/aes.h`)... Do not edit the `case` lines in `library/error.c`. They are regenerated at build time from the headers, so a manual edit is lost.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says to add the #define to the public header and not edit error.c, but it never says the define is /** */-documented or that the generator takes its description from that doc comment. It explicitly says it could not verify how the description text is obtained. It also says the build regenerates error.c rather than saying to re-run the generator.
